data.translation: Da sprach sein Wesir zu den Taiyiten: Dieser Hatim benimmt sich sehr hochfahrend gegen uns.

rationale: Body-part metaphor retained as idiom; no separate sense.

summary: New idiom: grəšle/gorəš tir w kavan 'den Bogen ziehen, abschießen'

data.headword: grəšle/gorəš tir w kavan 'den Bogen ziehen, abschießen'
data.turoyo: I naqqa d maġele bayn fəlgatte, mʕayašle bu tir w kavan l Nari, bayn dat tarte ʕaynayḏe grəšlele u tir w kavan diḏe.
data.translation: Als er sich niedergelegt hatte, zielte Nari mit Pfeil und Bogen auf seine Stirn und schoß ab.

rationale: Single weapon collocation; exact draw/discharge contrast left for editors.

summary: New idiom: grəšle/gorəš ǧaryan (mit l-) 'elektrische Leitungen verlegen, Elektrizität zuleiten'

data.headword: grəšle/gorəš ǧaryan (mit l-) 'elektrische Leitungen verlegen, Elektrizität zuleiten'
data.turoyo: ʕƏmumi aṯi bəṯr, manfaqwolle qanun, ʕəmum manfaqwolle l kul dəkṯo, l kul qriṯo, l kul bayto w l kul zabuqo gəd gərši ǧaryan ʕəmumi.
data.translation: The public supply came later. They had issued a law; they had issued it generally, to every place, to every village, every house and every street they would run public electricity.

rationale: New collocation, absent from targeted glossary lookup.

summary: New idiom: grəšle/gorəš heriš 'einen Angriff unternehmen'

data.turoyo: Maḥətle ḥa b qamuṯe, mərlele: "I tfənge b iḏox." Mədle qama bi idaṯe w xanǧar b haṯe, sayfo we, mədle b iḏe w grəšle heriš, mərle: "Hoo!"
data.translation: He put someone in front of him, told him: 'The rifle in your hand.' He took a knife in this hand and a dagger in that one, it was a sword, he took it in his hand and launched an attack; he said: 'Hoo!'

rationale: New attack collocation; one attestation only. Full weapon sequence makes the event clear.

summary: New idiom: grəšle/gorəš qopya, fotoqopi(ya) (mit ʕal) 'eine (Foto-)Kopie machen'

data.turoyo: Grašlox fotoqopi aʕle.
data.translation: Make yourself a photocopy of it.

rationale: One clear directive for the copying collocation; qopya noun and recipient -lən elsewhere confirm the frame.

summary: New idiom: grəšle/gorəš bolo d- 'jemandes Aufmerksamkeit erregen'

data.turoyo: Mede ḥreno, d lazəm gorəš bole du qaroyo, aḥ ḥaye mṭakse, d kətle lu xoriyo.
data.translation: Something else that should draw the reader's attention is the orderly life that this Xori has.

rationale: New collocation, absent from targeted glossary lookup.

summary: New idiom: grəšle/gorəš telġeraf, telġəraf (mit l-) 'ein Telegramm schicken'

data.headword: grəšle/gorəš telġeraf, telġəraf (mit l-) 'ein Telegramm schicken'
data.turoyo: Xori ʕAziz b əšme di ʕito səryayto w huwwe, xəd rišo ela, kgorəš telġəraf ġalabe qašyo l ḥasyo Maqaryos, u rayṣi-ǧəmhur d Qəbrəs. U telġəraf, xəd kətyo, kubele laġ ġazetat b Tərkiya ste.
data.translation: Father Aziz, in the name of the Syriac church and himself as its head, sends a very harsh telegram to Bishop Makarios, the president of Cyprus. The telegram, just as it stands, he also gives to the newspapers in Turkey.

rationale: New collocation, absent from targeted glossary lookup.
